vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2026-0235
vulnerability.description: rkyv: insufficient archive validation can cause out-of-bounds reads in archives containing Rc/Arc

statements.impact_statement: rkyv 0.7 appears in Cargo.lock only as an optional dependency of rust_decimal whose feature this workspace never enables. `cargo tree -i rkyv` prints 'nothing to print': no crate depends on it and it is never compiled into any artifact. The lockfile records optional dependencies regardless. Re-check if rust_decimal's `rkyv` feature is ever turned on.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv
vulnerability.description: extract-zip: path traversal when extracting a crafted archive

statements.impact_statement: extract-zip reaches site/pnpm-lock.yaml only through @lhci/cli -> lighthouse -> puppeteer-core -> @puppeteer/browsers, where it unpacks browser archives that puppeteer's own downloader fetches. This repository never runs that downloader: `pnpm run test:budget` points lhci at the Chromium playwright installed (CHROME_PATH), so no archive is ever extracted, and the package is a devDependency of the docs site that ships in no artifact. No fixed release exists to override to. Re-check if lhci is ever run without CHROME_PATH or if a fixed extract-zip is published.
